BalloonKeyFlyObjs.name: Balloon, flying coin, 1-up and key main
summary: Main routine for sprites $7D P-balloon, $7E flying red coin, $7F flying 1-up and $80 key (sprite number selects the case).
Movement: the balloon bobs and drifts right at X speed $0C; the others share it. Flying objects (state 2) sparkle and cycle their palette.
Contact: $7E gives 5 coins and score; $7F gives a 1-up; $80 becomes carryable on a stomp; $7D drops any carried sprite and puts Mario in balloon mode ([$13F3] = 9, [$1891] = $FF).
Quirk: the [$1540,X] branch at $01C203 (balloon rising) is unreferenced.

ChangingItemSprite.name: Table: changing item cycle order
summary: Sprite numbers cycled by ChangingItem: $74 mushroom, $75 flower, $77 feather, $76 star.

ChangingItem.name: Changing item (cycling power-up) main
summary: Sprite $81. Advances [$187B,X] each frame; every 64 frames it acts like the next power-up in ChangingItemSprite.
Temporarily swaps [RAM_SpriteNum] to that power-up, runs PowerUpRt, then restores $81 and reloads the sprite tables.

EatenBerryGfxProp.name: Table: eaten berry OAM properties
summary: OAM property (palette) bytes indexed by [$18D6], the type of berry being eaten.

FireFlower.name: Fire flower main
summary: Sets [$157C,X] to alternate 0/1 every 8 frames (flower flips) and falls into PowerUpRt.

PowerUpRt.name: Power-up sprite main (flower, mushroom, star, 1-up, feather)
summary: Shared routine for sprites $74-$78 and the coin $21. If [$160E,X] is non-zero the sprite is drawn as an eaten berry; otherwise it runs the item behaviour.

DrawBerryGfx.name: Power-up behaviour, contact and spark effect
summary: $01C358: draws an eaten berry (tile $80, palette from EatenBerryGfxProp[[$18D6]]).

$01C371: item behaviour. Dropped-from-item-box items ([$1534,X]) fall at speed $10 and blink; items emerging from a block ([$1540,X]) rise at -4; otherwise they move with gravity, bounce (coin, star), and turn at walls, then draw via CODE_01C61A.
$01C4AC: touch test. Ignored while still emerging ([$1540,X] >= $18) or while [$154C,X] is set. Collecting removes the sprite and jumps to TouchedPowerUp (coins get their own coin count and score).
$01C4F0: spawns effect type 5 (sparkle) in a free [$17C0] slot.

ItemBoxSprite.name: Table: item box value
summary: 20 bytes: (sprite - $74) * 4 + Mario power-up. Values: 0 nothing, 1 mushroom, 2 flower, 4 cape.

GivePowerPtrIndex.name: Table: power-up action
summary: 20 bytes indexed like ItemBoxSprite. Indices into HandlePowerUpPtrs: 0 grow, 1 no change, 2 star, 3 cape, 4 fire, 5 1-up.

TouchedPowerUp.name: Collect power-up: item box and action
summary: Y = (sprite - $74) * 4 + [$19]. Stores ItemBoxSprite[Y] in the item box [$0DC2] (sound $0B) when non-zero, then calls the action GivePowerPtrIndex[Y] via ExecutePtr.

NoItem.name: Run power-up action
summary: Entry that skips the item box store. A = GivePowerPtrIndex[Y], then JSL ExecutePtr.
Parameters: Y: table index.

HandlePowerUpPtrs.name: Pointer table: power-up actions
summary: 0 Big, 1 no change, 2 star, 3 cape, 4 fire, 5 1-up. Followed by an unreachable RTS.

GiveMarioMushroom.name: Give Mario a power-up (grow, star)
summary: Grow: Mario animation 2, timer $2F for the growth animation and sprite lock. Then $01C56F gives points (unless [$1534,X] is set) and plays sound $0A.
$01C580: star setup ([$1490] = $FF, music $0D, set bit 7 of [$0DDA]). Called by JSL. The source contains this block twice with different comments.

GiveMarioStar.name: Give Mario a star
summary: JSL to the star setup at $01C580, then branches to the shared points and sound code.

GiveMarioCape.name: Give Mario a cape
summary: Sets power-up 2, sound $0D, score, locks sprites, then CODE_01C5AE starts the transformation (animation 3, timer $18) and a smoke puff at Mario unless his position high bytes are non-zero.

GiveMarioFire.name: Give Mario fire power
summary: Flashing palette and sprite lock for $20 frames, Mario animation 4, power-up 3, then the shared points and sound code.

GiveMario1Up.name: Give 1-up score
summary: Awards score index 8 + [$1594,X] through GivePoints. Called for the flying 1-up.

PowerUpTiles.name: Table: power-up tile numbers
summary: Indexed by sprite - $74: mushroom $24, flower $26, star $48, feather $0E, 1-up $24, 4 unused, balloon $E4, flying coin $E8, flying 1-up $24, key $EC.

StarPalValues.name: Table: star palette XOR, and power-up draw
summary: $01C616: palette values XORed into the star's OAM property, cycled every 2 frames.
$01C61A: draws a power-up sprite: coin to CoinSprGfx, others to PowerUpGfxRt. In Mode 7 boss rooms (except Bowser) the OAM index is forced to $D8.

CoinSprGfx.name: Draw moving coin (long entry)
summary: Long-call wrapper for CoinSprGfxSub.

CoinSprGfxSub.name: Draw spinning coin
summary: Draws sprite $21. One 16x16 tile $E8 when spin phase = 0, else two 8x8 tiles (the second vertically flipped) from MovingCoinTiles.

MovingCoinTiles.name: Table: edge-on coin tiles
summary: Tiles for spin phases 1-3: $EA, $FA, $EA.

PowerUpGfxRt.name: Draw power-up tile
summary: Star gets a flashing palette XOR from StarPalValues. Sets OAM position (Y - 1), flip, priority [$64] and palette, tile = PowerUpTiles[sprite - $74], then finishes with a 16x16 tile.

NoFlashingPal.name: Draw power-up tile (non-star entry)
summary: Common part of PowerUpGfxRt: position, flip, property byte and tile of the power-up.

s01C6E6.name: Data: feather swing and fall tables
summary: DATA_01C6E6: X acceleration +2/-2. DATA_01C6E8: X speed limits $20/$E0. DATA_01C6EA: Y speed bases $0A, $F6, $08.

Feather.name: Feather main
summary: Floating cape feather: swings left and right (X speed +/-2 up to +/-$20) while falling at a speed from DATA_01C6EA + 6. Then tests contact (CODE_01C4AC) and draws (CODE_01C61A).
Special cases: sprites locked, status $0C, [$154C,X] set (falls straight with +1 per frame), [$C2,X] non-zero (block interaction until free).

InitBrwnChainPlat.name: Init brown chained platform
summary: Sets [$151C,X] = $80, [$1528,X] = 1 and moves the sprite by +$78 X and +$68 Y (16-bit), probably to the centre of its circular path.
